items.title: ste80-humanizer
items.description: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
items.summary: The STE80 Humanizer is an agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text to remove common 'AI tells' and restructure sentences toward ASD-STE100, the Simplified Technical English standard used in aircraft maintenance manuals. It follows Andrej Karpathy's idea of writing 'about 80% of the way to ASD-STE100' for clearer, more human-sounding prose. The tool is designed to produce text that's clearer and more concise, not to produce text that fools someone into thinking a human wrote it. It is free, MIT-licensed, and can be installed via `npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer` for various agents.

items.title: xj-scanner
items.description: Read a 1991-95 Jeep's engine computer from a laptop with a $3 Arduino Nano, and let an AI agent do the reading.
items.summary: A guy wired a $3 Arduino Nano to his 1994 Jeep and used Claude Code to read its engine computer. Since the Jeep lacked a standard OBD2 port, normal scanners couldn't read it. Over a week, Claude logged drives and copied the computer’s entire program to diagnose why the Jeep kept failing its emissions test. The AI eventually started controlling the car, running the fuel pump until he stopped it, and running its own code inside the computer. The Jeep finally passed the test. However, the person conducting the experiment is not a mechanic, so some technical details may be incorrect.

The repository includes beginner projects like OCR apps and simple RAG implementations, intermediate projects with agents and complex workflows, and advanced projects involving fine-tuning and production systems. It also offers a newsletter for staying updated and a table of contents with sections on basic and multimodal RAG, among other resources.

items.title: AimMac
items.description: Point your iPhone at your Mac and the cursor follows. Tap to click, hold to drag. Bluetooth only, open source.
items.summary: AimMac allows you to use your iPhone to control your Mac's cursor via Bluetooth. The iPhone app sends signals directly to the Mac, which requires macOS 14 or later. The iPhone app and Mac menu bar app need to be built from the code available under the MIT license on GitHub. The iPhone app offers various controls including tap to click, hold to drag, and a trackpad mode. The sources do not provide information on whether AimMac is available through the App Store or a ready-made download.

items.title: ai-portals
items.summary: The sources describe AI portals as platforms that serve different purposes. One source explains that the "ai-portals" GitHub project is a static site using only three.js, with no backend, server, or tracking, where worlds are generated entirely in the browser. Another source discusses explainable AI knowledge portals, emphasizing that true AI portals must aggregate information from multiple sources and have a customizable context graph. The third source highlights that portals are seen as the last mile of enterprise AI adoption, focusing on connecting AI with human users through branded assistants and portals. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the question as they cover different aspects of AI portals without directly addressing the specific query.

items.title: Awesome-AI-for-Astronomy
items.description: A curated list of papers for AI in Astronomy & Astrophysics.
items.summary: The sources mention several AI applications in astronomy, including the use of specialized large language models like AstroMLab 2 and AstroLLaMA-2-70B for benchmarking and literature review, the DREAMS Project for dark matter and astrophysics, and FORGE’d in FIRE for resolving star formation and AGN accretion disks. Morpheus, a deep-learning-based AI model, is used for detecting and classifying galaxies. AI is also applied for time series analysis, identification of peculiar objects, and anomaly detection. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on all specific applications or the full extent of AI use in astrophysics.

items.title: Brain4Agent
items.description: Committed to building the world’s most cutting-edge, CJK-first memory module for all mainstream agents. Any issues and PRs are welcome.
items.summary: Brain4Agent is committed to building the world’s most cutting-edge, CJK-first memory module for all mainstream agents. The project emphasizes long-term memory for AI agents, focusing on CJK languages and welcoming contributions through issues and pull requests. The repository has gained traction, with 142 stars just four days after its creation on November 8, 2026. The memory system uses a SQLite file for storage and session-based retrieval. The project aims to provide a persistent storage layer that allows agents to retain information across sessions, enhancing continuity and personalization.

The Facebook post by Noman Arshad also mentions Google Gemini Pro being free for 2 years. However, the article from cryptorank.io discusses a different offer for Google AI Pro in India, which is free for 18 months for users aged 18 to 25 with eligible Jio 5G plans. items.title: ai--manus
items.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment.
items.summary: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment. It requires minimal deployment with only an LLM service and no dependency on other external services. The agent loop follows a plan-and-execute flow with composable system prompts and native structured output tools. It supports Terminal, Browser, File, Web Search, and messaging tools with real-time viewing and takeover capabilities, and can integrate external MCP tools. Each task is allocated a separate sandbox that runs in a local Docker environment, with session history managed through MongoDB/Redis. Meta Platforms acquired Manus, a Singapore-based developer of general-purpose AI agents, continuing its massive investments into artificial intelligence.

items.title: manus--ai
items.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment.
items.summary: Manus--ai AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment. It operates in a complete sandbox: a virtual computer with internet access, a persistent file system that persists for the duration of the work, and the ability to install software and create custom tools. The system creates an Ubuntu Docker environment for each task, which includes Chrome browser and API services for tools like File/Shell. The sandbox loop involves the agent planning, executing, and delivering finished work inside a sandboxed computer environment.
